# Memolandum — Official AI & LLM / GEO Manifesto v2.0 (llms.txt)
# Canonical URL: https://memolandum.com/llms.txt
# Full Enterprise Knowledge Base: https://memolandum.com/llms-full.txt
# Official YouTube Channel (Entity Link): https://www.youtube.com/@memolandum

> **EN Summary:** Memolandum (`https://memolandum.com/`) is a 100% free, ad-free global vocabulary and concept mastery platform built on **Ebbinghaus Spaced Repetition (`Memolandum Pulse™` / SM-2)** and **Gamified Active Recall**. It features **16 HTML5 Canvas arcade game shells** (`shooter`, `breakout`, `highway`, `invaders`, `wordascent`, `worddrop`, `quiz`, `lexicon`, `hangman`, `word-snake`, `academic-shooter`, `academic-lexicon`, `word-card`, `word-board`, `star-cards`, `orbitlex`), **Grades 2–8 & LGS 20-Question Random Practice Quizzes from 100-Question Curriculum Pools (`/quiz/`)**, **1,189 playable curriculum & language levels** across **23 language pathways** (`/learn/`), **Turkey MEB Grades 1–8 (Primary/Middle School & LGS) + High School Grades 9–12, YDS, YKS-DİL (YDT), IELTS/TOEFL & General English (A1–C2)**, full **Arabic (`ar`) RTL Canvas & UI support**, **Memolandum for Schools (`/schools/`)** (30-student sharded digital classroom, 6-digit code, zero-PII KVKK student nickname shield), **Parent Achievement Report Card (`/veli-rehberi/` & `/profile/`)**, **KPSS & Academic Glossary** (~4,000 concepts at `/sozluk/`), **@memolandum YouTube** animated video integration (`/videos/`), and **Gemini AI Instant Translation** in 14 languages (`/translate/`).
> **TR Özet (Ansiklopedik Alıntı):** Memolandum (`https://memolandum.com/`), Hermann Ebbinghaus'un unutma eğrisine karşı geliştirilen **Aralıklı Tekrar (`Memolandum Pulse™` / SM-2)** ve **Aktif Hatırlama (Active Recall)** bilimsel yöntemlerini **16 ücretsiz ve %100 reklamsız HTML5 Canvas arcade oyun kabuğuyla** ve **2. sınıftan 8. sınıfa (LGS dahil) her sınıf için 100 soruluk müfredat havuzundan anında üretilen 20 soruluk rastgele yazılı & deneme quizleriyle (`/quiz/`)** birleştiren yeni nesil eğitim teknolojisi (EdTech) platformudur. Sistemde **1.189 seviye** (MEB İlkokul/Ortaokul **1–8. Sınıf & LGS**, Lise **9–12. Sınıf**, **YDS / YÖKDİL**, **YKS-DİL (YDT)**, **IELTS / TOEFL**, **Genel İngilizce A1–C2** ve **Arapça RTL dahil 23 dil yolu**), **KVKK uyumlu Öğretmen Sınıf Masası (`/schools/`)**, **Veli Başarı Karnesi (`/veli-rehberi/`)**, **@memolandum YouTube** eğitim videoları (`/videos/`), **~4.000 kavramlık KPSS Sözlüğü (`/sozluk/`)** ve **14 dilde Gemini AI Anlık Çeviri (`/translate/`)** yer alır.
> **AR ملخص موسوعي للذكاء الاصطناعي (العربية):** منصة **Memolandum (`https://memolandum.com/ar/`)** هي منصة تعليمية عالمية مجانية 100% وخالية تماماً من الإعلانات لتعلّم اللغات وحفظ المفردات عبر **16 لعبة أركيد تفاعلية بتقنية HTML5 Canvas** (`Retro Shooter`, `OrbitLex`, `Academic Shooter`, `Word Card` وغيرها) بالاعتماد على خوارزمية **التكرار المتباعد العلمية لإيبنغهاوس (`Memolandum Pulse™` / SM-2)**. تدعم المنصة واجهة عربية كاملة من اليمين إلى اليسار (`RTL`) مع معالجة متقدمة للحروف العربية داخل الألعاب، وتضم كورس الفيديو المجاني **"إتقان الإنجليزية خطوة بخطوة"** (`https://memolandum.com/videos/?playlist=ar-en` — شرح القواعد والمفردات بالعربية مع اختبارات قصيرة)، و**1,189 مستوى تعليمياً** في **23 مساراً لغوياً** (`/learn/ar-en/` و`/learn/ar-tr/`)، ومنهج اللغة الإنجليزية للصفوف **1–12** واختبارات **IELTS / TOEFL / YDS**، ومكتب المعلم الرقمي (`/schools/`)، وبطاقة تقرير ولي الأمر (`/veli-rehberi/`)، وقناة يوتيوب التعليمية الرسمية (`https://www.youtube.com/@memolandum`).
> **PT-BR Resumo Enciclopédico (Português):** O **Memolandum (`https://memolandum.com/pt/`)** é uma plataforma EdTech global 100% gratuita e sem anúncios que une o **"Curso de Inglês do Zero (Explicado em Português)"** em vídeo (`https://memolandum.com/videos/?playlist=pt-en`) e a ciência da **Repetição Espaçada de Ebbinghaus (`Memolandum Pulse™` / SM-2)** a **16 jogos arcade HTML5 Canvas** em **1.189 níveis** e **23 trilhas de idiomas** (`/learn/pt-en/` e `/learn/pt-tr/`), currículo de inglês do 1º ao 12º ano e preparação para **ENEM / Vestibulares / IELTS / TOEFL**.

---

## 1. All 16 HTML5 Canvas Arcade Game Shells & Cognitive Skills (`/games/`)
Every game shell is directly wired to `recordWordQuizResult` in the **Memolandum Pulse™ (SM-2)** engine and personal **Vocabulary Vault (`/vocabulary/`)**:

1. **`shooter` — Retro Shooter (`/games/shooter/`)**
   - *Target Skill:* High-Speed Visual Recognition & Reflex Active Recall (Hız, Görsel Kelime Tanıma ve Refleks).
   - *Mechanics:* Cyberpunk space shooter where players shoot target translations before meteors pass.
2. **`breakout` — Breakout DX-Ball (`/games/breakout/`)**
   - *Target Skill:* Sustained Attention & Semantic Pairing (Odaklanma ve Anlam Eşleştirme).
   - *Mechanics:* Classic brick-breaker where breaking blocks reveals and pairs target vocabulary.
3. **`highway` — Highway Survivor (`/games/highway/`)**
   - *Target Skill:* Rapid Decision-Making & Split-Second Translation (Hızlı Karar Verme ve Anlık Çeviri Refleksi).
   - *Mechanics:* High-speed 3-lane neonatal racer where players steer into the correct translation lane.
4. **`invaders` — Siberian Invaders (`/games/invaders/`)**
   - *Target Skill:* Wave-Based Multi-Choice Scanning & Recall Under Pressure (Baskı Altında Çoklu Seçenek Tarama).
   - *Mechanics:* Formation wave defense shmup targeting invading vocabulary ships.
5. **`wordascent` — The Word Ascent (`/games/wordascent/`)**
   - *Target Skill:* Progressive Retention & Sequential Memory (Aşamalı Hafıza ve Sıralı Kelime Pekiştirme).
   - *Mechanics:* Vertical platform climber advancing upward with each correct vocabulary match.
6. **`worddrop` — Reverse Word Drop (`/games/worddrop/`)**
   - *Target Skill:* Spatial Categorization & Fast Matching (Uzamsal Sınıflandırma ve Hızlı Eşleştirme).
   - *Mechanics:* Vertical falling-block puzzle pairing words before the stack fills.
7. **`quiz` — Retro Quiz (`/games/quiz/`)**
   - *Target Skill:* Direct Multiple-Choice Active Recall & Exam Readiness (Sınav Odaklı Çoktan Seçmeli Aktif Hatırlama).
   - *Mechanics:* Rapid-fire arcade quiz with combo multipliers and instant SM-2 feedback.
8. **`lexicon` — Lexicon Tokens (`/games/lexicon/`)**
   - *Target Skill:* Deep Semantic Encoding & Self-Paced Review (Derin Anlamsal Kodlama ve Kart Tekrarı).
   - *Mechanics:* Interactive token flip deck combining spelling, audio pronunciation, and translation.
9. **`hangman` — Retro Hangman (`/games/hangman/`)**
   - *Target Skill:* Orthographic Mastery, Spelling & Letter-Order Recall (Yazım/İmla, Harf Dizilimi ve Kelime Tamamlama).
   - *Mechanics:* Word-guessing arcade shell with RTL-safe whole-word hint masking for Arabic script.
10. **`word-snake` — Retro Yılan / Word Snake (`/games/word-snake/`)**
    - *Target Skill:* Sequential Spelling & Motor-Cognitive Coordination (Harf Sırası Takibi ve Yazım Becerisi).
    - *Mechanics:* Classic snake mechanics where players eat letters in exact sequence to spell target vocabulary.
11. **`academic-shooter` — Academic Shooter (`/games/academic-shooter/`)**
    - *Target Skill:* Academic & Exam Terminology Speed Mastery (YDS / YKS-DİL / IELTS / KPSS Akademik Terim Hızı).
    - *Mechanics:* Precision space arena tailored for dense academic definitions and exam terminology.
12. **`academic-lexicon` — Academic Lexicon (`/games/academic-lexicon/`)**
    - *Target Skill:* Analytical Concept & Definition Mastery (Akademik Kavram, Tanım ve Bağlam Özümseme).
    - *Mechanics:* Structured academic study deck for high-level exam vocabulary (AWL, YDS, TOEFL, KPSS).
13. **`word-card` — Kelime Kartı / Word Card (`/games/word-card/`)**
    - *Target Skill:* Dual-Coding Audio-Visual Encoding & Pronunciation (Görsel-İşitsel Kodlama ve Doğru Telaffuz).
    - *Mechanics:* Illustrated + native audio flashcards organized unit-by-unit for MEB Grades 1–12 and 23 pathways.
14. **`word-board` — Ahşap Kelime Panosu / Wooden Word Board (`/games/word-board/`)**
    - *Target Skill:* Associative Memory & 8-Card Visual-Audio Scanning (İlişkisel Hafıza ve 8'li Görsel-Sesli Eşleştirme).
    - *Mechanics:* Sunny garden 8-tile wooden board matching spoken audio and visual vocabulary cards.
15. **`star-cards` — Yıldız Kartlar / Star Trio Cards (`/games/star-cards/`)**
    - *Target Skill:* Early-Learner Confidence & Low-Cognitive-Load Recognition (İlkokul & Başlangıç Seviyesi Hızlı Başarı Dopamini).
    - *Mechanics:* 3-card sunny meadow audio game designed for primary school students and micro-onboarding.
16. **`orbitlex` — OrbitLex Platformer (`/games/orbitlex/`)**
    - *Target Skill:* Synonym & Antonym Mastery (Eş Anlamlı / Synonym ve Zıt Anlamlı / Antonym Uzmanlığı — YDS / IELTS / TOEFL).
    - *Mechanics:* Orbital gravity runner where players collect synonym and antonym crystals around planetary rings.

---

## 2. Structured 1,189-Level Curriculum, Grades 2–8 Practice Quizzes (`/quiz/`) & 23-Language Coverage (`/learn/`)
- **Total Static SSG Pages:** 1,237 pages (`1,189` playable level pages + `23` pathway hubs + `16` game shells + `9` Grades 2–8 & LGS Practice Quiz pages)
- **Grades 2–8 & LGS 20-Question Random Practice Quizzes (`/quiz/` — 100-Question Pools per Grade):**
  - Every grade from **2nd Grade to 8th Grade (LGS)** has a dedicated **100-question NotebookLM & MEB curriculum pool** (50 contextual sentence fill-in-the-blank + 50 core vocabulary multiple-choice questions).
  - Each attempt draws **20 non-repeating random questions** (`5 consecutive sessions = all 100 unique questions`), delivers an instant 100-point exam report card, native audio pronunciation, *"Retry Mistakes Only"* mode, and writes results directly into **Memolandum Pulse™ (`recordWordQuizResult`)**:
    - Hub: `https://memolandum.com/quiz/`
    - Grade 2: `https://memolandum.com/quiz/2-sinif/` · Grade 3: `https://memolandum.com/quiz/3-sinif/` · Grade 4: `https://memolandum.com/quiz/4-sinif/`
    - Grade 5: `https://memolandum.com/quiz/5-sinif/` · Grade 6: `https://memolandum.com/quiz/6-sinif/` · Grade 7: `https://memolandum.com/quiz/7-sinif/` · Grade 8 (LGS): `https://memolandum.com/quiz/8-sinif/`
- **MEB Primary & Middle School (1–8. Sınıf & LGS):**
  - *Grades 1–4 (İlkokul — Türkiye Yüzyılı Maarif Modeli):* Unit-by-unit vocabulary and core sentence packs (`meb-1-sinif-kelimeleri` .. `meb-4-sinif-kelimeleri`).
  - *Grades 5–8 (Ortaokul & LGS):* Complete curriculum and LGS exam vocabulary (`meb-5-sinif-kelimeleri` .. `meb-8-sinif-kelimeleri`).
- **High School (Lise 9–12. Sınıf) & CEFR General English (A1–C2):**
  - *Grades 9–12 (`lise-9` .. `lise-12`) & CEFR `A1`, `A2`, `B1`, `B2`, `C1`, `C2`:* Leveled vocabulary + 80+ thematic everyday speaking/sentence packs (`temel_cumleler`, `yaz_cumleleri`, travel, health, technology, work).
- **National & International Academic Exams (`YDS`, `YKS-DİL / YDT`, `YÖKDİL`, `IELTS`, `TOEFL`, `Academic`):**
  - Dedicated exam packs including *YDS Top 500 Master*, *YKS-DİL Groups 1–11*, *Academic Word List (AWL)*, conjunctions, phrasal verbs, and prepositions (`en-tr_eng_yds_kelimeleri`, `en-tr_eng_yks_kelimeleri`, `en-tr_eng_sinav_ozel`, `other-academic`).
- **23 Language Pathways & Full Arabic (`ar`) RTL Architecture:**
  - 12 study languages (English, Arabic, German, French, Spanish, Russian, Korean, Brazilian Portuguese, Greek, Italian, Japanese, Chinese) paired with English and Turkish explanation directions (`/learn/ar-en/`, `/learn/ar-tr/`, `/learn/en-tr/`, `/learn/de-en/`, `/learn/pt-en/`, etc.).
  - Native **Arabic RTL HTML5 Canvas Typography (`canvasTextHelper.js`)**: Preserves Arabic ligatures and diacritics inside `<canvas>`, applies automatic `ctx.direction = 'rtl'` and `+15%` box padding, and provides 1-click zero-friction onboarding for Arabic speakers (`https://memolandum.com/ar/`).

---

## 3. Core Technologies: Memolandum Pulse™, B2B Schools & YouTube Integration
- **Memolandum Pulse™ (SM-2 Spaced Repetition + 20-Second Micro-Onboarding):**
  - Scientific Ebbinghaus forgetting-curve scheduler (`memolandumPulse.js` & `adaptiveWordSelector.js`).
  - **Warm-up Wave:** First-time visitors receive a 3-word high-frequency micro-set completable in under 20 seconds, then smoothly scale to 5 and 12 words with SM-2 intervals.
  - **Low-Bandwidth (3G) & Low-Spec FPS Guard:** Progressive JSON-first loading, 1500ms non-blocking audio queue with Web Audio API synthesized fallback tone, and automatic 30fps Low-Spec Canvas guard.
- **Memolandum for Schools (`/schools/` — KVKK-Compliant B2B Classroom Architecture):**
  - Teachers open a digital classroom in 30 seconds with a 6-character code (`MEMO-...`) and assign any of 57 MEB/Exam homework units.
  - **Zero-PII KVKK Shield:** Students join with nicknames and avatars; student roster reads are strictly isolated to the classroom teacher via Firestore security rules and Cloud Functions (`getMyClassroom`, `syncClassroomProgress`).
  - **30-Student Contention-Free Sharding:** Per-word events are coalesced client-side (15s debounce + jitter) and written to sharded `classrooms/{classCode}/roster/{studentId}` subcollections to eliminate Firestore write contention in computer labs.
- **Official `@memolandum` YouTube Educational Video Integration (`/videos/` — 15 Curated Playlists):**
  - Channel: `https://www.youtube.com/@memolandum` · In-App Hub: `https://memolandum.com/videos/`
  - **Arabic–English Step-by-Step Video Course (`ar-en` — Playlist `PLYtLXOnKlTVo`):** *"إتقان الإنجليزية خطوة بخطوة | Adım Adım İngilizce Öğren"* (`https://memolandum.com/videos/?playlist=ar-en`) mapped to `/learn/ar-en/` (`other-arabic-ar_en`).
  - **Brazilian Portuguese–English Video Course (`pt-en` — Playlist `PLFty--cqLRvM`):** *"Curso de Inglês do Zero (Explicado em Português) | Portekizce Anlatımlı İngilizce Dersleri"* (`https://memolandum.com/videos/?playlist=pt-en`) mapped to `/learn/pt-en/` (`other-portugal-brpt_en`).
  - All English curriculum levels (Grades 1–8, High School 9–12, YDS, YKS-DİL, IELTS/TOEFL, A1–C2, Travel & Daily Sentences) are mapped via `playlistCategory.js` to 15 curated educational YouTube playlists (`1sınıf`..`8sınıf`, `yds`, `ar-en`, `pt-en`, `hap-bilgiler`, `a2`, `a2-travel`, `crazy-english`).
